basic_info.description: Located in San Francisco's sought-after Fillmore shopping district in Pacific Heights, this elegant Italianate Victorian home offers 3 bedrooms, 3 full baths, an entertainment/guest room with separate entrance, up to 3-car parking and an outdoor oasis for indoor-outdoor living. The entry level features a sophisticated living room with a gas fireplace, a formal dining room, and a remodeled kitchen with marble counters and a breakfast bar opening into a cozy family room. French doors lead to a secluded outdoor oasis with a gas fire pit. A full bath completes this level. Upstairs, there are 3 bedrooms and a full bath with laundry. The primary bedroom has a deck overlooking the garden and a staircase to the outdoor space. There is a second gas fireplace on this level, also adorned with a stunning stone surround. The lower level includes a 4th room and full bath, ideal for guests or an office. A large garage plus built-in storage is also on this level. This Pacific Heights Charmer is in the heart of Fillmore Street, with vibrant shopping, cafes, restaurants and services.  Nearby choose between Lafayette or Alta Plaza Parks. This home has been meticulously maintained and remodeled, retaining its historic charm while updated for today's modern lifestyle.
